title: On the Trinity
english: Of Epiphanius of Cyprus, from the discourse On the Trinity.
One glorification of Father and Son and Holy Spirit, and one worship; for when the seraphim glorify God with "Holy, holy, holy" (Isaiah 6:3), they glorify the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
Single-paragraph fragment witness (Khazarzar one-page PDF); open-only, no rem sections.
